_comment: The languages the shell's copy is in (GAP#L11). presentation.json is the
base and holds every string; each listed locale is <tag>.json beside this
file, a partial copy of presentation.json's text laid over it at startup.
fallback is the base or a locale listed above; a string a locale leaves
out comes from there. A test locale is never offered to players.
COLOURWARS_LOCALE=<tag> chooses one. docs/localisation.md is the contract.
